title: Critical Resource Status

fields.incidentName: Core Collapse — Mass Casualty Surge During a Network Outage

resources.name: ED Capacity
resources.notes: 64 of 90 spaces occupied; hallway and Pavilion C overflow in use

resources.name: ICU 3 North
resources.notes: 16/16 beds occupied; no free spaces

resources.name: ICU 3 South
resources.notes: 16/16 beds occupied; no free spaces

resources.name: PACU Overflow
resources.notes: 6/10 beds occupied; 6 ICU overflow patients

resources.name: Operating Rooms
resources.notes: ORs 1–5 in use; ORs 6–8 staffed but waiting on trauma cases

resources.name: O-Negative Blood Units
resources.notes: 4 units remaining; 6 critical patients pending transfusion

resources.name: Ventilators
resources.notes: 31 of 38 in use; 7 available but not yet deployed

resources.name: Secure Messaging
resources.notes: Down across all departments; communications rely on paper and phone

resources.name: PACS
resources.notes: Down; no imaging access for trauma or pre-op review

resources.name: EHR
resources.notes: Read-only access on 60 terminals; no new entries allowed

resources.name: Staffed Beds
resources.notes: 340 occupied; census 351; 11 patients awaiting placement

resources.name: Replacement Network Switch
resources.notes: Courier ETA 21:30; hardware not yet received

instructorNote: This board confirms capacity strain and two critical shortages: ventilators and O-negative blood. The AOC must initiate external requests immediately.
